2. The learned Counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner had complied with all the terms and conditions.

However, the same is not considered.
The grounds which were raised to hold the Petitioner ineligible also apply to Respondent No.3.
The learned Counsel further submits that the case of Respondent No.3 suffers from conflict of interest.
